about: The Aquemi studio: every development tool that sits beside the website, in one registry. Hand-written; tools/studio.py, studio.html and the studio bar (studio/studio.js, generated from this file by the build) all read it. Add a tool here and it appears everywhere. See studio/README.md.

release.about: Which published copies carry the studio. true: the copy is the tooled draft (studio bar, tool pages, generated tool data). false: the copy is the live site, made by `python tools/studio.py release`, with every studio file left out; the tooled copy of main then moves to /studio/. /live/ always shows the released copy of main, so the live site can be reviewed before the switch.

live.about: What the live site is: the only files `python tools/studio.py release` copies. Paths are relative to the repo root; a folder takes everything in it, `*` matches inside one folder. Anything not listed is studio or source and stays behind. tools/studio.py check proves every file the live site asks for is here.
live.strip: Between <!-- studio --> and <!-- /studio --> in index.html: the studio bar, its stylesheet and script. The release copy is checked for any reference to a studio page.

tools.name: Site
tools.what: The website itself, rendered from content/pages/*.json through the design system. In the studio it carries the studio bar: placeholder highlighting, open facts per page, a page jump and a link to that page's history.
tools.when: Edit copy, add a page, check a page in place.

tools.name: Design system
tools.what: The visual guide: brand book, tokens in both themes, every component with its README and live preview, every page block with real content. Generated at load time from design-system/.
tools.when: Before building any UI; after changing a token or component, to review it in light, dark and phone width.

tools.name: Section library
tools.what: Every look (section design) the site has had, live or retired, rendered with its motion from every content it has shown, grouped by block type, with a phone-width toggle. Looks are never deleted.
tools.when: Before inventing a section: find a look that fits the block type. After page edits: snapshot so every content version is kept.

tools.name: Design research
tools.what: The image loop for people to read: each section's Gemini concept and what it became, every image taken apart into keywords, themes, the style atlas, build notes, skills and briefs.
tools.when: After new concepts, descriptions or build notes; when writing new image prompts.

tools.name: Media gallery
tools.what: Every image made or considered for the site, used or not, tagged by what became of it: Gemini originals, rebuild captures, equipment drawings, icons, the brand and build records.
tools.when: After adding any image; when looking for an earlier concept.

tools.name: Page history
tools.what: Any page as it was at each named checkpoint or at any commit on main, flipped or compared side by side, desktop or phone. Old commits run unchanged from content-addressed copies.
tools.when: After a release to main you want listed; to compare a page before and after a change.

tools.name: Studio
tools.what: This hub: every tool, what it reads and writes, the command that refreshes it, the agent skills, and what the live site leaves out.

external.name: Claude design system
external.what: The design system published for Claude chats, decks and designs. Publish after design-system changes (skill aquemi-design-system).

external.name: Source on GitHub
external.what: The repository: dev for work, staging for review, main for production.

skills.name: aquemi-studio
skills.what: Work with the studio: find the right tool, refresh what a change made stale, check, release the live site, add a tool.

skills.name: aquemi-design-system
skills.what: Tokens, components, page blocks and looks; publishing to the Claude design system.

skills.name: image-prompt-loop
skills.what: Describe images, refresh the style atlas, write prompts, generate Gemini concepts.

skills.name: motion-library
skills.what: Port motion from the Subframe Motion library (MCP server subframe-motion) to GSAP and tokens.
